mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book (seller_id, course_id, title, isbn, original_price, selling_price, condition_desc, cover_img_path, status) VALUES (#{sellerId}, #{courseId}, #{title}, #{isbn}, #{originalPrice}, #{sellingPrice}, #{conditionDesc}, #{coverImgPath}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT b.book_id, b.seller_id, b.course_id, b.title, b.isbn, b.original_price, b.selling_price, b.condition_desc, b.cover_img_path, b.status, b.publish_time, u.username AS seller_name, u.credit_score AS credit_score, c.course_name AS course_name FROM book b LEFT JOIN `user` u ON b.seller_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN course c ON b.course_id = c.course_id WHERE b.book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET status = '已预定' WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND status = #{status}
UPDATE book SET status = #{status} WHERE book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT b.course_id FROM `order` o JOIN order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN book b ON oi.book_id = b.book_id WHERE o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} AND o.status = '已完成' AND b.course_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT book_id, seller_id, course_id, title, isbn, original_price, selling_price, condition_desc, cover_img_path, status, publish_time FROM book WHERE status = '在售' ORDER BY publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT b.book_id, b.seller_id, b.course_id, b.title, b.isbn, b.original_price, b.selling_price, b.condition_desc, b.cover_img_path, b.status, b.publish_time, u.username AS seller_name, u.credit_score AS credit_score, c.course_name AS course_name FROM book b LEFT JOIN `user` u ON b.seller_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN course c ON b.course_id = c.course_id ORDER BY b.publish_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET status = '已下架' WHERE book_id = #{bookId}
UPDATE book SET status = '已下架' WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status = '在售'
